_about: Existing to-buy entries: the edition to look for (ISBN of the matching design). Libib re-imports overwrite to-buy.json, so these may belong in a separate file the build applies.

akvei6dpsz.title: Guards Guards (original paperback)
akvei6dpsz.note: Corgi 1990, matches her set. Boxed-title first printing (lspace scan). The same ISBN was reprinted with the later big-lettering cover, which is what Amazon/AbeBooks show: check the cover when buying.
